nodes.label: FrameWork Platform
nodes.rationale: Open film collaboration platform designed for film students and indie filmmakers in India to journey from Idea to Credits.

nodes.label: Filmmaking Collaboration Workflow
nodes.rationale: Idea -> Script -> Post Project -> Find Crew -> Build Team -> Make Film -> Credits -> Portfolio -> Next Film.

nodes.label: Filmmaker & Crew Roles
nodes.rationale: Matches creators needing script/vision execution with editors, cinematographers, actors, sound designers, VFX artists.
